items.text: One bar to speak from: the candle, what is happening, and your words to correct.
items.alt: A small candle flickers beside a moving line; above it a dashed note fills with words, and a painted Send button sits at the bottom

items.text: Read aloud marks the sentence being read, and dots show how many are left.
items.alt: Three sentences; a soft underline moves from the first to the second to the third while three dots light in turn

items.text: Swipe an adviser's message to the right, or tap Reply, to answer that adviser.
items.alt: A message slides a little to the right and springs back; a line reading Answering Socrates appears below it
